Wall mount or ceiling mount — each creates a unique feel in your space, offers a distinct look, and requires different support.
Here’s a quick guide to help you choose the one that fits your home best.

Wall Mount (Side Mount)

For a side-mount installation, please ensure your wall offers solid support.

  • Suitable: concrete wall, brick wall, or wood-framed / stud wall.
  • Not suitable alone: drywall or CMU / concrete block wall — these require anchoring directly into a wood stud behind the drywall.

If solid support isn’t available, we recommend choosing a ceiling mount instead.

Ceiling Mount

For a ceiling-mount installation, the ceiling must also be strong and stable.

  • Suitable: concrete ceiling, or ceiling with wood joists (mounted directly into the joist).
  • Not suitable: drywall-only ceilings or suspended/drop ceilings, unless reinforced.

For any questions or assistance, please contact us at care@cozyology.com.
We're dedicated to ensuring your experience with Cozyology is seamless and satisfying.
